payload.rationale: This document is a Phase 2 E2E test reproducing the missing-id failure pattern (## heading with no id field) and asserting the pipeline must not crash and must produce a valid slug. It directly extends the existing Narrative_AutomatedIdentifierGenerationAndFallback and the unplaced Position_PipelineIdGenerationFallback, both of which frame exactly this scenario: submissions without explicit id fields requiring slug derivation and successful commit. I expanded both expressions under that position/narrative so the passes can bind this document's assertions to the prior witnessed claims (the 'must produce a slug' decision and the 'submitted without an explicit id field' claim). I also expanded the prior Sample document (Sample_1SampleMemoryWithDistinctiveHeading) since this Phase 2 document is its direct successor, and Actor_XenaExpertgh as the sole participant/voice. No thematic areas exist in this graph (Thematic door returned zero areas), and the ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst node surfaced in the focus tail is a strategy/methodology decision unrelated to ID derivation, so it was deliberately not expanded.
